purpose: Maak de duurzame Make/Powerhouse control-plane learnings uit de actuele chat automatisch beschikbaar aan iedere toekomstige Brain-preflight zonder incidentinhoud te dupliceren.
invariants: Conversation text is not canonical truth; durable material learnings must be reachable from Brain preflight.
Known blockers are stateful and deduplicated; unchanged blockers must not repeatedly trigger paid learning/recovery work.
Shared context and learning are control-plane services: cache-first, event-driven, globally coalesced and budget-bounded.
NON_MATERIAL agent outcomes invoke BG168 zero times; MATERIAL outcomes invoke it at most once and never suppress the primary result.
status=paused together with isActive=true is containment evidence, not proof of structural deactivation.
A moving main requires rebuild only on file/semantic/contract overlap; non-overlapping drift preserves the exact tested candidate.
State-changing connector calls that return ambiguous 429/5xx require readback before retry.
Secrets, credentials, tokens and capability values never enter learning artifacts or user-visible evidence.
No autonomous paid Make-capacity increase is permitted to obtain runtime proof.
open_obligations: Runtime-write of the new resume-hazard learning to BG166 is blocked while the Make organization/team is paused by capacity/data-transfer limits.
Before Make resumes normally, inventory all PH-agent BG168 callers and prove caller-side materiality guards in staged runtime canaries with bounded credit slope.
BG167/BG168/BG184 and affected PH agents remain fail-closed until their relevant runtime acceptance evidence exists.
completion_rule: Complete only when this v3 source is mandatory in compiled chat-learning preflight, its linked incident fingerprints are observable there, regression-tested through BRAIN delivery and read back from main after merge.
